moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's last public holiday of the summer, the August Bank Holiday, falls on Monday, August 31st for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, making it a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Long weekend incoming! The August Bank Holiday is next Monday (31st) for most of the UK. Planning a getaway or staying local? Expect busy roads and public transport.

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of summer next Monday! How are you making the most of the long weekend before autumn officially kicks in?

moments.title: Back to School for many UK Kids
moments.blurb: Most schools in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are set to return for the autumn term in the first week of September, typically between September 1st and 4th.

angles.name: School Run Prep
angles.copy: Uniforms ready? Lunchboxes packed? Many across England, Wales & Northern Ireland are heading back to school next week! Wishing all students (and parents!) a smooth return.

angles.name: Freedom for Parents
angles.copy: That bittersweet moment is almost here! Kids in England, Wales & NI are back to school next week. What's the first thing you're doing with your newfound peace?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Continues
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival continues at Victoria Park until August 30th, with headline sets from Tyler, The Creator (August 28-29) and Twenty One Pilots (August 30) still to come.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is still buzzing in Victoria Park! Who are you hyped to see between now and Sunday? Tyler, The Creator and Twenty One Pilots are still to hit the stage.

angles.name: APEFest Headliners
angles.copy: Get ready, London! Tyler, The Creator (Aug 28/29) and Twenty One Pilots (Aug 30) are set to close out All Points East. What tracks are you hoping to hear?

moments.title: Creamfields Kicks Off This Week
moments.blurb: The UK's premier electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27-30, featuring world-class DJs including Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Tiësto, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Dance Anthem Mecca
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is just days away! Daresbury is about to become the epicentre of electronic music this Bank Holiday weekend. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Weekend Warm-up
angles.copy: The countdown to Creamfields is ON! Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Tiësto... the line-up is massive. Get ready for an unforgettable Bank Holiday weekend.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Begin
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds twin festivals run from August 27-30, 2026, across the Bank Holiday weekend, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds 2026 is almost here! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park for the Bank Holiday madness? Line-up is stacked!

angles.name: Headline Picks
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. – Reading & Leeds has something for everyone this weekend. Which headliner are you most excited for?

moments.title: Premier League Tonight: Fulham vs Chelsea
moments.blurb: Tonight, Monday, August 24th, sees a London derby in the Premier League as Fulham host Chelsea.

angles.name: London Derby Kick-off
angles.copy: Monday night football! Fulham take on Chelsea in the Premier League tonight. Who's taking the West London bragging rights? #FULCHE

angles.name: Match Prediction
angles.copy: It's Fulham vs Chelsea tonight. After a mixed start to the season for both, this is a big one. Score predictions? #PL

moments.title: Man Utd's Shock Opening Day Defeat
moments.blurb: Manchester United suffered a surprise 2-0 defeat to newly-promoted Hull City on the opening day of the Premier League season, drawing strong criticism from pundits like Alan Shearer.

angles.name: United's Woes
angles.copy: Still reeling from Man Utd's opening day loss to Hull City? Alan Shearer certainly is, calling them 'dreadful'. What went wrong for Carrick's side?

angles.name: Hull's Dream Start
angles.copy: What a start for Hull City! Beating Man Utd 2-0 on their Premier League return. Is this a sign of things to come for the Tigers?

moments.title: Brydon Carse Under ECB Investigation
moments.blurb: England fast bowler Brydon Carse is under investigation by the ECB after footage emerged of him in police handcuffs outside a Derby nightclub on Saturday night, though he was released without charge.

angles.name: Cricket Controversy
angles.copy: Another off-field incident for English cricket. Brydon Carse is being investigated by the ECB after being pictured in handcuffs. What are your thoughts on the latest news?

angles.name: Player Conduct
angles.copy: Brydon Carse's nightclub incident is making headlines. How much responsibility do professional athletes have for their actions off the pitch/field?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Latest
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for August 20-26, 2026, sees 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean holding strong at No.1, with Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' at No.2 and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' at No.3.

angles.name: Chart Toppers

angles.name: New Music Vibes

moments.title: Happy Birthday Jean-Michel Jarre
moments.blurb: French electronic music pioneer Jean-Michel Jarre turns 78 today. He is known for his groundbreaking albums like 'Oxygène' and 'Équinoxe'.

angles.name: Electronic Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Jean-Michel Jarre! The electronic music trailblazer behind 'Oxygène' and 'Équinoxe'. What's your favourite of his tracks?

angles.name: KISS Icon

moments.title: Happy Birthday Elvis Costello

angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the phenomenal Florence Welch on Thursday! And she's celebrating by headlining Reading & Leeds this weekend. What a legend!

moments.title: UK 'Multi-City' World Cup 2042 Bid Discussed
moments.blurb: Andy Burnham has expressed a desire for the men's World Cup to return to the UK in 2042, with discussions including a 'multi-city bid' to spread economic benefits.

angles.name: World Cup Dreams
angles.copy: Could the Men's World Cup return to the UK in 2042? Andy Burnham is pushing for a 'multi-city bid'. Which cities would you want to see host games?

angles.name: Football's Future
angles.copy: Talk of a UK World Cup bid for 2042 is buzzing. It's a long way off, but the idea of hosting again is exciting! What are your thoughts?
